kill_condition.rationale: The voice claims to reduce the named residual by at least 30%. Failure to meet that threshold falsifies the prediction. The threshold is computable from the voice's run output alone, with no external reinterpretation required.

input_parameters.station_set: default rotating-load-profile (5 stations: peak, off_peak, mixed, spike, peak)

verdict.rationale: Observed unsigned cycle_residual 0.0465 exceeds the pre-committed threshold 0.0326. Voice enters the null-voice ledger per §3.4 and stays on record.
